text: Bank of India pulled in seventy five thousand crore of deposits in ninety days.
Clue one. That's forty four percent of its whole year's deposit growth, in one quarter.
Clue two. In the same quarter, it lent only twenty nine thousand crore in India.
The twist. Its loan to deposit ratio fell, from eighty two to seventy eight percent. The fastest deposit growth of the eight government banks that have reported.
Plenty of fuel to lend. But will this money stay after the quarter ends? Back to the napkin.
